author: Nerdstalgic
description:
For four seasons, The Good Place managed to make the afterlife feel completely unpredictable. Every new chapter seemed to challenge what we thought we knew about the show, its characters, and even the nature of being a good person. So it's strange that, near the finish line, the series stumbled into one of its most frustrating episodes.

The story feels like an unnecessary detour, built around a character who's almost impossible to root for. After years of clever twists and meaningful character growth, it's hard not to wonder why The Good Place is spending so much time going in circles. But beneath all that frustration, there might be something more interesting happening than meets the eye.

Because The Good Place has always been interested in whether people can truly change. And sometimes, the answer isn't nearly as satisfying as we'd hope.

title: How This Became The Worst Episode Of The Good Place
